result: Macro form audit: 8265 macros / 13480 (macro, header) pairs x 8 configurations; 12042 pairs match, 1438 pairs (1024 macros) differ; probe landed as a header_check module in report mode with a failing self-control

gate.affected: 685 passed / 0 failed (direct tier, mei:headers-macro-form-audit-gate3); plants 7 of 7 caught

rulings.item: C1: about 1200 C++ rows where the reference's macro has an enumeration type and libniji's an int literal (_SC_*, nl_item, MSG_*, MS_* under D-X.126/COMPAT-34, ...)
rulings.recommendation: emit the enumerator in C++ (match the type); revisit D-X.126 for MS_*

rulings.item: D1/D2/E1: #if usability and header self-sufficiency differences (libniji more permissive)
rulings.recommendation: match only where a program can tell (D1: code compiling on libniji fails on the reference); low priority

informational: A1 PTHREAD_STACK_MIN constant in <pthread.h>/<dirent.h> where the reference is a run-time long (gnu, dynstack, C++); <limits.h> matches
A2 MINSIGSTKSZ/SIGSTKSZ do not compile in libniji under _GNU_SOURCE, _DYNAMIC_STACK_SIZE_SOURCE and C++: <signal.h> does not declare sysconf

B2 <sys/vlimit.h> INFINITY is the float INFINITY; the reference's is an int constant
B3 MS_NOUSER is not a file-scope array size in libniji (cause not diagnosed)
Probe found its own bugs through its control: -w and system-header suppression hid implicit declarations (fixed)
